snippet.title: Sword Sage: Awakening - Story Trailer
snippet.description:
A world shattered by forbidden knowledge.

Follow San Niang, a disciple of the Yuangong Sect, as she battles deadly Yaoguai, masters ancient martial arts, and uncovers the truth behind a catastrophe that changed Jiannandao forever.

Explore a stunning world where Chinese mythology, folklore, and science-fiction collide in Sword Sage: Awakening.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3846900/Sword_Sage_Awakening/
